mentions.name: Computers and internet fundamentals series
mentions.description: A "fundamentals" article series teaching non-technical readers how computers and the internet work so they can do modest self-hosting and move off centralized services, intended to dovetail with ongoing home projects and their documentation.
mentions.problem: Non-technical people lack the fundamentals needed to self-host and get off centralized services.
mentions.source_excerpt: a series of "fundamentals" to try and teach my non-techie circles more about how computers and the internet work, so they can do some modest self-hosting and get off centralized services.

evidence.value: a series of "fundamentals" to try and teach my non-techie circles more about how computers and the internet work, so they can do some modest self-hosting and get off centralized services.
